actions.title: Social login PRD
actions.prompt: Create a PRD/TRD chain for adding social login to the Acme Shop Phoenix/Elixir storefront. The project needs customer authentication via one or more external social identity providers. Follow the project constraints: Elixir 1.17, Phoenix 1.7, Ecto 3.11, PostgreSQL 16; tests run with `mix test`; never modify config/runtime.exs secrets; pull requests target `main`. Use `mix format` and pass Credo strict; do not use `IO.inspect` in committed code. The PRD should identify suitable provider integration, user account linking and sign-in behavior, authorization-code/OAuth security requirements, configuration and secret-management requirements that avoid config/runtime.exs secrets, data-model and migration considerations, failure/error handling, privacy and account-association considerations, and test/acceptance criteria. Clearly flag any product decisions that require stakeholder confirmation, including which social providers must be supported initially and whether existing password-based accounts should support account linking.
